item.text:
**Assessment:** mostly no. I found repeated evidence of censorship, arrests of journalists, intimidation of rights groups, and a closed civic-space environment. Direct positive evidence that Abiy protected independent media or information access in 2024 is thin to absent.

- **World Report 2024: Ethiopia** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-12 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia | HRW says authorities restricted social media, arrested opposition figures and journalists, and used emergency powers in ways that narrowed political space. This is direct evidence against protecting independent information access. | `4B.6`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-04 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent | HRW reported the detention of an opposition spokesperson and a journalist, plus broad arbitrary detention under emergency powers. This is strong evidence of pressure on journalists and critics, not protection. | `4B.6`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia: Journalist arrested under state of emergency: Belay Manaye** | Amnesty International | 2024-03-14 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr25/7782/2024/en/ | Amnesty said a journalist was detained under emergency powers for reporting on the Amhara conflict, and that other journalists had also been arbitrarily arrested. This is direct evidence of censorship and intimidation of media workers. | `4B.6`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups | HRW said the government suspended three rights groups while Abiy praised reforms like media freedom and NGO registration. The operational result was selective punishment of independent monitors, not protection of an open information environment. | `4B.6`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `4B.2`
- **Ethiopia - CIVICUS Monitor** | CIVICUS Monitor | 2024-12-04 | https://monitor.civicus.org/press_release/2024/ethiopia/ | CIVICUS downgraded civic space to “Closed,” citing surveillance, harassment, intimidation, and threats against journalists and opposition members. This is strong evidence against media freedom and independent information access. | `4B.6`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`
- **The state-of-emergency proclamation** | ENA English | 2024-11-03 | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124 | The proclamation restricted CSOs and media suspected of aiding “terrorist” groups, imposed ID/movement controls, and centralized enforcement under an operation command. This is official evidence of censorship-like controls and pressure on media-adjacent actors. | `4B.6`, `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels** | Reuters via EHRC | 2024-02-27 | https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/ | Reuters reported a secret security committee that interfered in the justice system and was linked to widespread rights violations. This reinforces the broader pattern of coercive control over information and scrutiny, though it is not a direct media-specific item. | `4B.6`, `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.9`
- **Actors of Protection Ethiopia - February 2024** | GOV.UK | 2024-01-12 | https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ethiopia-country-policy-and-information-notes/country-policy-and-information-note-actors-of-protection-ethiopia-february-2024-accessible | The note says the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission receives complaints and that some institutions implemented its recommendations on human-rights protections and prison conditions. This is only weak, indirect positive evidence of some oversight capacity, not proof of media freedom or information-access protection. | `4B.6`, `4B.4`, `3B.9`

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Abiy proactively protected independent media owners, journalists, or broad information access.
- The best available positives are indirect oversight/complaint-handling references; they do not offset the direct censorship and intimidation record.
